reasons: Card gives only area-level red-flag counts; individual F01-F28 / R01-R19 IDs are withheld, so reasons cite area counts instead.
Numeric warning signals 3 of 4 computable (Beneish M, Dechow F, accruals >3% of assets, OCF < 0.8x NI): most quantitative earnings-quality screens are tripped, the strongest signal on the card.
Internal control and audit 1 of 4: one of material weakness / adverse ICFR / auditor change / disagreement is present, a meaningful control-environment concern.
Prior-period corrections 1 of 3: a restatement/revision, accounting change or segment change is present, consistent with prior reporting problems or reshaping of disclosures.

Financial pressure 2 of 4 and management turnover 1 of 2: pressure (e.g. capital raise, earnings-tied incentive pay, covenant or going concern) combined with CEO/CFO change raises incentive/opportunity risk.
Transaction complexity 2 of 8 is modest; investigations and litigation 0 of 3 (no SEC, class action or government probe disclosed) moderates the score.
Overall about 10 flags spread across most areas with heavy numeric signals, but no investigation flags: elevated but not high risk.
